notes: The owner settled the shape on 2026-09-22 and it is recorded as D-092: being somewhere exposes you to possibly like-minded people, and your actions and personality drive the relationship from there. Proximity produces candidates, not bonds. This request is the mechanism under that decision, not a re-asking of it.

WHAT SHIPS TODAY, measured at de6a71cc. deriveRelationshipSummary (src/simulation/queries.ts:230-263) sums one signed magnitude over every interaction ever recorded between two people and buckets the total: below zero estranged, three or more close. Only an explicitly negative interaction lowers it and elapsed time never does, so three ordinary agreeable exchanges make two people close for the rest of both lives. Nothing in that path reads either person's temperament or anything either of them chose.

AND WHAT IS ALREADY BUILT UNDERNEATH IT. relationship-integration.ts already records participant-specific memory and appraisal, and assessRelationshipContinuity already separates recent-contact, long-gap, reconnected and tension-context. The lossy part is the consumer, not the record. So an answer here lands on seams that exist rather than asking for a second engine.

THE INTERACTION VOCABULARY. RelationshipInteractionKind is a namespace plus a free content key (types.ts:661-673), the namespaces being contact, work, experience, support, exchange, conflict, commitment, care, mentorship and other. change is formed, strengthened, maintained, strained or ended; significance is minor, meaningful or major. An answer can therefore speak in these terms without inventing a schema.

THE PACE HAS A PRECEDENT TO MATCH. He has already settled that personality change is paced by how strongly a trait is held, and the numbers under that are themselves out for research as personality-change-bands. A relationship answer that contradicts that pacing would leave the two systems disagreeing about how fast a person changes.

ONE MEASURED ASYMMETRY WORTH ANSWERING DIRECTLY. Agreeing to work together is recorded; being turned down is recorded nowhere, with a comment saying a refusal is not a grievance (people-study.ts:269). So today a relationship can only ever be built by these paths, never damaged by them.
question: Given that conduct and temperament drive relationships rather than proximity: (1) Which conduct should move a relationship, and by how much — is agreeing to help someone once worth the same as keeping a promise, or as turning them down twice? (2) Which traits should bear on it, and in which direction: should somebody conciliatory hold a relationship together through a disagreement that would end one between two confrontational people, and should somebody reserved simply accumulate fewer occasions rather than worse ones? (3) At what pace should a relationship fade when nothing happens — is a year of silence between two people who were close a change in the relationship, or only a change in what the next meeting feels like? (4) Should a refusal ever be recorded as a thing that passed between two people, or is the current position right that being turned down is not a grievance? (5) Can a relationship end, as distinct from decaying to nothing — is there a conduct that makes two people no longer know each other?

title: What conduct and which traits should move a relationship, and how fast
usableAnswer: A short list of conduct with a direction and a rough weight for each, worked against one example a player would recognize; a position on which of the five ordinary-life traits bear on relationships and how; and a pace for fading, consistent with the personality pacing already settled. Ranges rather than exact numbers are fine. Any answer lands on records that already exist.
whyItMatters: This is the owner's first priority stated as a mechanism. Today a relationship is a running total that only goes up, so a person's character decides nothing about who is in their life, and nobody ever drifts apart. Getting the weights wrong is invisible to every test: too generous and everybody is close to everybody, too harsh and nobody ever becomes close to anyone, and both look identical in a passing suite.

answer.summary:
Replace the single closeness sum as the authoritative interpretation with the already approved actor-specific warmth, trust, respect, commitment and unresolved tension over the existing interaction/appraisal history. The current source treats most maintained interactions as positive, adds 1/2/3 and declares close at 3; conflict-prefixed records are negative regardless of a more nuanced outcome. These rules also feed whether a person is close to someone affected by an event. This is a consequential reader connection, not cosmetic labeling.

Record intent, attempt and fulfillment separately. Agreeing to help creates a commitment and may affect anticipation; delivering meaningful help supplies evidence about reliance. A competent result can increase respect without friendship. A disagreement can preserve affection, a breach can reduce trust without destroying shared history, and an apology need not restore what it acknowledges. Do not use the namespace alone to decide direction: a successful conflict resolution is not automatically harm.

A normal refusal is a recorded response, not automatically a grievance or punishment. A witnessed contemptuous rejection or refusal violating an actual duty can be appraised differently. Reserved people may prefer different encounter forms or initiate less often; they are not assigned worse relationship quality. Conciliatory people can choose repair without consenting to abuse; confrontational people can maintain loyal friendships. A long gap changes context and possible expectations, not an automatic affection tax. End contact/partnership with a real action or event; do not erase knowing someone.

The supplied conduct rubric gives qualitative direction and illustrative bounded contribution ranges for private test only. These are weights of evidence on separate interpretations, not emotional measurements or thresholds that promise friendship after N actions. Evidence deduplicates by the underlying encounter/obligation and acknowledges magnitude, stakes, consent, alternatives and actor interpretation. Test whether ordinary interactions can sustain an actual friendship over time without grinding.

Acceptance ChatGPT requests (not executed): Three greetings do not establish enduring trust or closeness. One significant fulfilled obligation is distinguishable from three promises. A recorded refusal survives as a response without a compulsory penalty. A repair interaction can reduce tension without erasing the breach. Ten idle years do not apply an affection tax.
